# Spec: Greeting

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| ID | 001-demo |

## Acceptance criteria

| ID | Criterion |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Given a name, when greet runs, then it returns "Hello, <name>" |
| AC-2 | Given an empty name, when greet runs, then it returns "Hello, guest" |
| AC-3 | Given a name with spaces, when greet runs, then the spaces are trimmed |
